# End-to-end gtk4 platform compile test.
#
# Uses an inline minimal GIR fixture (Button, Label, Box, ApplicationWindow)
# passed via --opt gir= so the test runs deterministically without requiring
# system GTK4 dev files.

sngl compile --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt=main=true --opt=gir=Gtk-4.0-test.gir --out=out main.sngl
exists out/model.go
exists out/callbacks.go

# cgo preamble: GTK header include
grep '#include <gtk/gtk.h>' out/model.go

# cgo enabled
grep 'import "C"' out/model.go

# Button constructor from the inline GIR (gtk_button_new_with_label is the
# first/only constructor in the fixture, exercising the GIR-driven ctor path).
grep 'gtk_button_new_with_label' out/model.go

# Box and ApplicationWindow constructors should also flow through.
grep 'gtk_box_new' out/model.go
grep 'gtk_application_window_new' out/model.go

# GTK app entrypoint emitted in callbacks.go (snglActivate is the //export'd
# activate handler hooked to the GApplication).
grep 'snglActivate' out/callbacks.go

-- Gtk-4.0-test.gir --
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<repository version="1.2"
  xmlns="http://www.gtk.org/introspection/core/1.0"
  xmlns:c="http://www.gtk.org/introspection/c/1.0"
  xmlns:glib="http://www.gtk.org/introspection/glib/1.0">
  <namespace name="Gtk" version="4.0">
    <interface name="Orientable">
      <property name="orientation" writable="1">
        <type name="Orientation" c:type="GtkOrientation"/>
      </property>
    </interface>
    <class name="Button" c:type="GtkButton">
      <constructor name="new_with_label" c:identifier="gtk_button_new_with_label">
        <parameters>
          <parameter name="label" transfer-ownership="none" nullable="1">
            <type name="utf8" c:type="const gchar*"/>
          </parameter>
        </parameters>
      </constructor>
      <property name="label" writable="1">
        <type name="utf8" c:type="gchar*"/>
      </property>
      <glib:signal name="clicked">
        <return-value transfer-ownership="none">
          <type name="none" c:type="void"/>
        </return-value>
      </glib:signal>
    </class>
    <class name="Label" c:type="GtkLabel">
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_label_new">
        <parameters>
          <parameter name="str" transfer-ownership="none" nullable="1">
            <type name="utf8" c:type="const gchar*"/>
          </parameter>
        </parameters>
      </constructor>
      <property name="label" writable="1">
        <type name="utf8" c:type="gchar*"/>
      </property>
    </class>
    <class name="Box" c:type="GtkBox">
      <implements name="Orientable"/>
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_box_new">
        <parameters>
          <parameter name="orientation">
            <type name="Orientation" c:type="GtkOrientation"/>
          </parameter>
          <parameter name="spacing">
            <type name="gint" c:type="int"/>
          </parameter>
        </parameters>
      </constructor>
      <property name="spacing" writable="1">
        <type name="gint" c:type="int"/>
      </property>
    </class>
    <class name="CheckButton" c:type="GtkCheckButton">
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_check_button_new"/>
      <constructor name="new_with_label" c:identifier="gtk_check_button_new_with_label">
        <parameters>
          <parameter name="label" transfer-ownership="none" nullable="1">
            <type name="utf8" c:type="const gchar*"/>
          </parameter>
        </parameters>
      </constructor>
      <property name="active" writable="1">
        <type name="gboolean" c:type="gboolean"/>
      </property>
      <property name="label" writable="1">
        <type name="utf8" c:type="gchar*"/>
      </property>
      <glib:signal name="toggled">
        <return-value transfer-ownership="none">
          <type name="none" c:type="void"/>
        </return-value>
      </glib:signal>
    </class>
    <class name="Image" c:type="GtkImage">
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_image_new"/>
      <property name="file" writable="1">
        <type name="utf8" c:type="gchar*"/>
      </property>
    </class>
    <class name="ScrolledWindow" c:type="GtkScrolledWindow">
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_scrolled_window_new"/>
    </class>
    <class name="ApplicationWindow" c:type="GtkApplicationWindow">
      <constructor name="new" c:identifier="gtk_application_window_new">
        <parameters>
          <parameter name="application">
            <type name="Application" c:type="GtkApplication*"/>
          </parameter>
        </parameters>
      </constructor>
      <property name="title" writable="1">
        <type name="utf8" c:type="gchar*"/>
      </property>
      <property name="default-width" writable="1">
        <type name="gint" c:type="int"/>
      </property>
      <property name="default-height" writable="1">
        <type name="gint" c:type="int"/>
      </property>
    </class>
  </namespace>
</repository>

-- main.sngl --
component main {
    var count int

    platform gtk4 {
        GtkApplicationWindow(title="Test") {
            GtkBox(orientation="vertical") {
                GtkLabel(label="hello") {}
                GtkButton(label="click me", @clicked { count = count + 1 }) {}
            }
        }
    }
}
